name: nurok-kb
description: Read, search, inspect, and synthesize Nurok knowledge bases through the CLI or MCP without changing remote state.

interface.longDescription: Read and search Nurok KBs through remote MCP by default, including on supported mobile hosts, then answer from revision-pinned evidence. CLI reads are optional when explicitly requested in an environment with shell access.
defaultPrompt: Answer from a Nurok KB through remote MCP with source evidence.
Search a Nurok KB and cite the relevant sections.
Inspect a Nurok KB's metadata and revision history.
